title: Edge connectivity of a critical graph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite graph on a nonempty vertex set, and let $k$ be a natural number. If $G$ is $k$-critical — that is, $G$ has chromatic number $k$ and every proper subgraph of $G$ has strictly smaller chromatic number — then the edge connectivity of $G$ satisfies $\kappa'(G) \ge k - 1$; equivalently, $G$ is $(k-1)$-edge-connected.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite graph (Fintype V)
G is k-critical: chromatic number k and critical
